column1: # public-preview rows promote a layout: its module is packages/styles/layouts/<layout>.css,
# its hook is the class .ds-<layout>, and its contract is in docs/architecture/layouts.md.
# The other rows record each candidate that was evaluated and not promoted, with a reason
# code: consumer (stays consumer-owned), deferred (no multi-consumer evidence yet), or
# rejected (conflicts with a layout rule). None is a backlog commitment.
# ds-check layout keeps layouts/*.css, this file, the document, and fixtures/layouts in agreement.
